name: Sonicware LIVEN Texture Lab
source: Sonicware LIVEN Texture Lab manual r2 + MIDI implementation chart (sonicware.co.jp/DL/LIVEN_TextureLab/DOC/); CC spacing for stepped options measured on hardware 2026-10-16 (filter type 0/42/84/127, mod assign 0,9…108,127)
liveNote: the Texture Lab can't be asked for its settings — knobs follow its panel as you turn them, send pushes every control, patterns live in edit's library
setup: DIN both ways: interface out → Texture Lab MIDI IN, its MIDI OUT → interface in.
On the unit, FUNC + key 10 (MIDI), pressed repeatedly to step through: RX.CH = edit's channel (or ALL), TX.CH = the same channel, TX.CC = ON (so panel moves reach edit), M.OUT = OUT.

For pattern select from edit: M.PC = RX.TX and PC.CH = the same channel — PC.CH is its own setting and defaults to 16 (a factory reset puts it back), so check it first if the program dropdown does nothing. While a pattern plays, a change waits for the pattern's end.
Nothing can be read back: when you connect, edit's knobs are guesses until you move them (on either side) or press send.

edit keeps your patterns (Dropbox): store files the current sound under the pattern number; selecting that number later loads the unit's pattern and pushes edit's sound on top — no button on the unit, so it works racked. (The Texture Lab itself can only save from its panel: FUNC + PTN, then OK.)
Hover any control: the line under the program bar says what it does and where it lives on the unit (shift = hold A/a, FUNC = hold func).

programs.note: program change 0-127 = 8 banks × 16 patterns, shown bank·step as on the unit (bank 1 = factory). Needs M.PC = RX on the unit

params.name: Sample
params.note: which of the 32 sample slots the grains are cut from. In EFX mode this knob is line-in level instead

params.name: Pitch
params.note: transposes the grains, ±2 octaves (−24.0 … +24.0 semitones); noon = original pitch

params.name: Position
params.note: where in the sample grains start — 0 … 6 s across the knob. EFX mode: delay time before the first grain (4 ms … 5.9 s)

params.name: Length / Feedback
params.note: how wide a window after POSITION the grains are drawn from — small = one focused spot, large = smeared across the sample. EFX mode: feedback

params.name: Blend
params.note: plain sample vs grains: 0 = the sample playing straight, 127 = grains only

params.name: Size
params.note: length of each grain, 2 ms … 1 s. Short = buzzy, pitched texture; long = smooth overlapping chunks

params.name: Shape
params.note: the fade-in/out window on every grain: clicky and hard ↔ soft and blurred

params.name: Timing
params.note: how often new grains start. Noon = LUSH (densest); left = longer free intervals (M values); right = tempo-synced 1/32 … 1/1

params.name: Jitter
params.note: random wobble on when each grain starts — 0 = a steady stream, up = scattered

params.name: Density
params.note: how many grains overlap, 1 … 64 (cap depends on voice mode: poly 16/voice, mono 32, legato 64). Past noon it also detunes them

params.name: Diffusion
params.note: stereo spread — grains scattered across left/right

params.name: Speed
params.note: playback speed, ¼× … 4×; noon = normal (the manual calls it grain playback speed — it also drives the plain sample). Off in EFX mode

params.name: Direction
params.note: first arrow = which way grains travel through the sample, second = which way each grain plays. >< and <> bounce; rnd = random. EFX mode uses only the first three

params.name: Pos Rnd Rate
params.note: how fast the grain position jumps around randomly

params.name: Pos Rnd Depth
params.note: how far those random position jumps reach

params.name: Grain Rnd Size
params.note: random variation of SIZE, rolled per grain

params.name: Grain Rnd Shape
params.note: random variation of SHAPE, rolled per grain

params.name: Mod 1 Assign
params.note: what LFO 1 moves

params.name: Mod 1 Shape
params.note: LFO 1 waveform; steps = stepped random-ish staircases, keyboard = follows the key played

params.name: Mod 1 Rate
params.note: LFO 1 speed (4/1 … 1/32 of a bar when MOD SYNC is on)

params.name: Mod 1 Depth
params.note: how far LFO 1 moves its target

params.name: Mod 1 Fade In
params.note: LFO 1 eases in over 0 … 8 s after each note

params.name: Mod 1 Retrig
params.note: restart LFO 1 on every note

params.name: Mod 2 Assign
params.note: what LFO 2 moves

params.name: Mod 2 Shape
params.note: LFO 2 waveform

params.name: Mod 2 Rate
params.note: LFO 2 speed

params.name: Mod 2 Depth
params.note: how far LFO 2 moves its target

params.name: Mod 2 Retrig
params.note: restart LFO 2 on every note

params.name: Mod Sync
params.note: lock both LFO rates to the tempo (4/1 … 1/32)

params.name: Attack
params.note: fade-in of each note, 0 … 5 s. Off in EFX mode

params.name: Release
params.note: two zones: 0–41 = gate time (notes cut to 10–90% of their length), 42–127 = release tail 0 … 5 s after the key lets go

params.name: Filter Type
params.note: low pass, high pass or band pass — off bypasses it

params.name: Cutoff
params.note: filter frequency, 70 Hz … 14.4 kHz

params.name: Resonance
params.note: filter peak (Q 0.3 … 10); on BPF it sets the band's width instead

params.name: Reverb Type
params.note: reverb space — infinite never decays

params.name: Shimmer
params.note: how much octave-up shimmer feeds the reverb

params.name: Reverb Mix
params.note: reverb level

params.name: Line In → Reverb
params.note: sends whatever is on LINE IN straight into the reverb

params.name: Voice Mode
params.note: poly = 4 voices; mono retriggers each note; legato glides without retriggering; arp arpeggiates held keys

params.name: Voice Adjust
params.note: depends on voice mode — mono/legato: glide time 0 … 10 s; arp: arp type (up, down, up-down, … random, play order) in 12 steps across the knob

params.name: Octave
params.note: keyboard octave

params.name: Velocity
params.note: the fixed velocity the keyboard plays at

params.name: Pattern Level
params.note: this pattern's output level (before VOL)

params.name: Swing
params.note: delays every even step, 0 … 75%

params.name: Transpose
params.note: shifts the sequence's notes in semitones

params.name: Random Step
params.note: the chunk size the sequence random function shuffles, in steps (random itself: FUNC + 1/5)

params.name: Seq Mode
params.note: not documented — probably normal / random / stutter (the FUNC + 1/5 and 2/6 functions)

params.name: Param Lock
params.note: plays back per-step knob values recorded into the pattern — while on, a locked control snaps back every step, so turning it sounds jumpy (factory patterns are full of them); turn off to tweak freely. Record one: hold a step key + turn a knob; clear all: CLR + PRM LOCK

params.name: EFX Mode
params.note: granulates LINE IN live instead of a sample; POSITION becomes delay time, LENGTH/FB feedback

params.name: EFX Note
params.note: in EFX mode, the keys repitch the effect relative to the low C

params.name: Freeze
params.note: stops the grain position where it is (EFX mode: freezes the 6 s input buffer). On the unit, hold FREEZE + OK to latch it
